finding: A newly surfaced public Morocco-wide roaming/status surface at map.watt.ma documents OCPI 2.2.1 location/tariff interfaces and a GET-only live-status proxy. It also exposes a concrete FastVolt station status on the public map. This is useful as an independent diagnostic/roaming cross-check, but it must not overwrite native CPO attribution or native status when fresher first-party data exists.

live_status_contract.note: The documentation says the proxy calls an external CPO endpoint only when partner credentials are configured server-side. No credentials are required or stored by this report.

concrete_public_example.note: Treat this as WATT.ma roaming/aggregation evidence, not as FastVolt-native status evidence.

cpo_operator.rule: Retain the independently validated physical CPO/operator. A WATT.ma listing or status must never establish or overwrite CPO attribution by itself.

site_brand.rule: Retain the physical host/site brand independently from the charging operator and roaming surface.

app_source_access_network.value: WATT.ma public map / OCPI aggregation surface

tariff_channel.rule: Any tariff from WATT.ma is a WATT.ma/OCPI aggregation or roaming tariff unless independently proven identical to the CPO direct tariff. Do not label it direct by inference.

status_source.rule: Prefer a fresh native source such as cp.evgo.ma for EVGO/Nareva when available. Use WATT.ma to detect disagreement, roaming lag, or missing native visibility.

evone_cross_check.use: WATT.ma can provide an independent third status observation when comparing EVOne roaming freshness against native CPO status.
evone_cross_check.production_rule: EVOne-derived production candidates remain allowlisted to Available, Occupied or Charging only.

safety.note: The documentation also mentions POST command routes, but they were neither probed nor used.
